Daily Quiz.question: ১) Who wrote poem about Lucy?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Wordsworth is the pioneer of Romantic Age. He is called Poet of Nature, Poet of Childhood, Lake poet. He wrote poem about Lucy. Famous poem of William Wordsworth: Poems in Two Volumes, Lyrical Ballad, The Excursion, The Daffodils, The Prelude, Lucy Poem, Tintern Abbey, The Solitary Reaper, Ode to Duty, My Heart Leaps Up etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) 'The Falcon' is a famous comedy by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Lord Alfred Tennyson was a Victorian Poet and playwright. He was represented/ Lyric poet of the Victorian Age. His famous Comedy is 'The Falcon'.
His famous poems are Oenone, Ulysses, Lotus Eaters, Locksley Hall, Tears Idle Tears, Tithonus, The Two Voices, The Lady of Shalott, Vision of Sin, Morte D'Arthur etc and
Queen Marry, Harold are the famous comedy of Lord Alfred Tennyson.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Who is a writer of the Romantic age?
Daily Quiz.exp: Matthew Arnold, Charlotte Bronte and Robert Darwin are the Victorian Poet. Jane Austen is the Romantic novelist. She is called an anti-romantic novelist in the Romantic age because of her stern attitude against youthful passion.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Who wrote 'Patriotism'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Sir Walter Scott is the Scottish historical novelist, playwright and poet. His famous novels are Ivanhoe, Talisman, Patriotism, Waverly.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who is the 'Lake poets' in the following list?
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) All of the above writers
Daily Quiz.exp: 'Lake Poets' is a group of English Romantic poets who lived in the Lake District. They were William Wordsworth, Samuel Taylor Coleridge, Robert Southey and Thomas De Quincey.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Who is the writer of 'The Essays of Elia'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Charles Lamb was an English Poet and Essayist. The Essays of Elia, The Last Essays of Elia, Tales from Shakespeare etc his famous Essays.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who wrote 'Treasure Island'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
R. L. Stevenson was a Scottish Novelist, Poet, Essayist and travel writer. His notable works are Treasure Island, Kidnapped, The New Arabian Night, The Black Arrow, Prince Otto.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) 'Ode on a Grecian Urn' who is the poet of the poem?
Daily Quiz.exp:
'Ode on a Grecian Urn' is the famous poem by John Keats. He is called the poet of beauty. His famous writings are Endymion, Hyperion, Ode to Psyche, A part of Lovers, Bright Star, A daughter of Sunshine, Lamia, Ode to a Nightingale, ode to Autumn, The eve of St. Agnes etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Who wrote 'North and South'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Elizabeth Cleghorn Gaskell is popularly known as Mrs. Gaskell. His famous works are North and South, Mary Barton, Cranford, Ruth, Sylvia's Lovers.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Who was English Poet addicted to opium?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Samuel Taylor Coleridge is an English Poet, critic and philosopher. He contributed a lot to the Romantic Movement in English Literature. He was addicted to opium.
He was a collaborator of William Wordsworth in the publication of the Lyrical Ballads.
He is mostly known for his brilliant poem 'The Rime of the Ancient Mariner' in which an old sailor narrates an adventurous story of his voyage in the sea to the marriage guest in a fantastic manner.
He is also remembered for his literary critique 'Biographia Literaria'.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Who wrote the Novel 'Moby Dick'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Herman Melville was an American Novelist. His famous novels are Moby Dick (It deals with a white whale), White Jacket, Bartleby, the Scrivener.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who is the writer of 'The Vision of Judgement'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Lord Byron, Rebel poet of English literature. The Vision of Judgement, Hours of Idleness, Heaven and Earth are his famous book. Don Juan is his famous epic.
Source: An ABC of English Literature and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who is famous for his 'A Defense of Poetry'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
P. B. Shelley is known as Revolutionary Poet, Lyrical Poet, Poet of Wind and Poet of Hope and Regeneration.
Notable works of Shelley: Prometheus Unbound, Adonais, A Defence of Poetry, Ode to the West Wind, To a Skylark, The Revolt of Islam, Ozymandias, Alaster, Ozymandias, Queen Mab, The Cloud.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Which one was written by Gustave Flaubert?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Madame Bovary, Sentimental Education, The Temptation of Saint Anthony etc are the writings of Gustave Flaubert. Pride and Prejudice was written by Jane Austen. The New Arabian Night was written by R. L. Stevenson and Biographia Literaria was written by S. T. Coleridge.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) The Literary work 'Kubla Khan' is-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) A history by John Keats
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) A story by Charles Lamb
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) A novel by Jane Austen
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) A verse by S. T. Coleridge
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Literary work 'Kubla Khan' is a verse by S. T. Coleridge. His notable poems are The Rime of the Ancient Mariner, Dejection: An Ode, Christabel, A Christmas Carol.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Who wrote 'Pagan Papers'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
The notable works of Kenneth Grahame are Pagan Papers, The Golden Age, Dream Days, The Reluctant Dragon, The Headwoman etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Who wrote the novel 'Kidnapped'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
R. L. Stevenson was a Scottish Novelist, Poet, Essayist and travel writer. His notable works are Treasure Island, Kidnapped, The New Arabian Night, The Black Arrow, Prince Otto.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who is not a Victorian Poet?
Daily Quiz.exp: Alfred Lord Tennyson, Thomas Hardy, Charles Dickens are the Victorian writer and Lord Byron is the Romantic Poet. He is called Rebel Poet of English literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Wordsworth was inspired by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Wordsworth is the Romantic Poet. He was inspired by The French Revolution in 1789. He is known as Poet of Nature, Lake Poet, Poet of Childhood. He is believed in Pantheism.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) 'Marriage of Hell and Heaven' written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Blake was both Poet and Painter. His famous books are Marriage of Hell and Heaven, Songs of Innocence, Songs of Experience etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) Lyrical Ballads was the published in the year of-
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Wordsworth and Samuel Taylor Coleridge jointly published the Lyrical Ballads in 1798. The Romantic age began in 1798 with the publication of Lyrical Ballads.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) 'The Rime of the Ancient Mariner' is a-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Samuel Taylor Coleridge is an English Poet, critic and philosopher. He contributed a lot to the Romantic Movement in English Literature. He was addicted to opium.
He was a collaborator of William Wordsworth in the publication of the Lyrical Ballads.
He is mostly known for his brilliant poem 'The Rime of the Ancient Mariner' in which an old sailor narrates an adventurous story of his voyage in the sea to the marriage guest in a fantastic manner.
He is also remembered for his literary critique 'Biographia Literaria'.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) Who wrote the poem 'Don Juan'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Lord Byron was a leading figure in the Romantic Movement in English Literature. He is considered to be the Rebel Poet and Byronic Hero in English Literature. Don Juan is his famous poem.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) Who is the following was both a poet and painter?
Daily Quiz.exp:
An English poet, painter and printmaker, William Blake was the precursor of the English Romanticism. He was both a poet and a painter. He is most remembered for his collection of poems titled Songs of Innocence and of Experience.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) Who wrote the Novel 'Mansfield Park'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Jane Austen is called an Anti-romantic novelist in the Romantic age because of her stern attitude against youthful passion. Her famous novels are Pride and Prejudice, Sense and Sensibility, Mansfield Park, Emma, Persuasion etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) The Solitary Reaper is a poem written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Solitary Reaper is a poem written by William Wordsworth. His famous poems are Lucy Poem, Lyrical Ballad, The Prelude, Poems in Two Volumes, The Excursion, The Daffodils, Tintern Abbey, The Solitary Reaper, Ode to Duty, Ode to on Intimations of Immortality, I wander Lonely as a Cloud etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) 'Ode to the West Wind' is by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Title of P. B. Shelley is Revolutionary Poet, Lyrical Poet, Poet of Wind, Poet of Hope and Regeneration. He was expelled from Oxford University for atheism. He was drowned while he was crossing the Adriatic Sea in 1822.
His famous poems are Ode to the West Wind, To a Skylark, Ozymandias, The Cloud, To Night, Song of Proserpine etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) What period does the poet Alfred Tennyson belongs to?
Daily Quiz.exp: Alfred Tennyson belongs to the Victorian Period. He is famous for his Melodious Language. He was made Poet laureate in 1850.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) Who wrote 'Ode to a Nightingale'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Keats is called the Poet of beauty. His famous works are Ode to a Nightingale, Endymion, Hyperion, Lamia, ode to Autumn, Ode to Psyche, A part of Lovers, Bright Star, A daughter of Sunshine, Give Me Women, Wine, and Snuff, The eve of St. Agnes etc. Source: Live MCQ lecture.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) Who wrote the poem 'My Heart Leaps Up'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Wordsworth wrote the poem 'My Heart Leaps Up'. His famous poems are Poems in Two Volumes, Lyrical Ballad, The Excursion, The Daffodils, The Prelude, Lucy Poem, Tintern Abbey, The Solitary Reaper, Ode to Duty, Ode to on Intimations of Immortality, I wander Lonely as a Cloud etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.
